title: 保管所まで二駅
subject: taking the train two stops to pay 2,500 yen and get your bicycle back from the city impound lot
caption: Japanese melodic punk in the melocore style. Two electric guitars playing downstroked power chords, palm-muted in the verses and opening into ringing chords in the chorus, fast two-beat punk drums with kick and snare alternating eighth notes and a crash on every bar, a pick-played bass doubling the root notes. Dry, tight and loud, the guitars wide left and right, the voice forward with no reverb tail. Male voice, a high clear tenor singing bright melodies, with gang shouts from the band on the answer lines. 196 BPM, D major. Furious, then laughing at it. No orchestral layers, no synths, no key change, no screamed lead vocal, no ballad breakdown, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars and two-beat drums]

[Verse 1]
駅前の柵の横に 五分だけ停めた
ほんとに五分 パン買っただけ
戻ったら ない 黄色い紙が一枚
「撤去しました」 やけに丁寧な字で

[Pre-Chorus]
保管所は 二駅先の 川の向こう
自転車を取りに 電車で行く

[Chorus - gang shouts]
二千五百円!
五分で 二千五百円!
パンは百八十円 ふざけんな
今から取り返しに行く

[Verse 2]
保管所のおじさん 優しいのがむかつく
「みんなそうなんですよ」って 判子押す
千台並んだ中から 自分のを探す
サドルに貼った ガムテ 見つけた瞬間 ちょっと泣いた

[Chorus - gang shouts]
二千五百円!
五分で 二千五百円!
パンは百八十円 ふざけんな
帰りは川沿い 全力で漕ぐ

[Bridge - gang shouts]
オイ オイ
次は駐輪場
一日百円 払ってやるよ

[Outro - last chord rings, cut]
パン 潰れてた
[Song ends abruptly]
